observations.observation: The entire original map and its three complete water regions were inspected. Lake Ohrid (re-designate) appears over the western water in a conservation overlay. Prespa Lake Monument of Nature is a designation over part of the larger eastern cross-border water. The separate southeastern water lies within the Prespa National Park (GR) setting without a distinct waterbody label. The legend distinguishes lake water from conservation hatching and international boundaries. Those overlays do not establish shorelines or naming partitions.
